scope: Resume the unchanged SynthText recipe/checkpoint to 2 complete epochs, then full MLT17 train 100 epochs and LATeD development branch 250 epochs. Public initialization only, no custom connectors, no model test evaluation, ESTR60 sealed. Single GPU time is authorized without a training-duration cap; queue timeout is a seven-day operational bound. Acceptance requires matching data/metric protocols and at most 3 percentage points from the paper. CTW target follows shared pretraining after its original GT/evaluator protocol is fixed.
